---
title: Show every observation, not just a summary
description: A strip chart draws each observation as a point, one strip per category, spreading overlapping points sideways in a fixed order.
version: 0.0.1
styles: [scientific]
---

## Every score is on the page

These illustrative scores show each team's spread and where scores tie. Overlapping points are moved sideways in value order, so the same data always gives the same picture; sideways position means nothing.

```chart
type: strip
title: West scores bunch tightly; North and South spread wider
subtitle: One point per score; points that would overlap are spread sideways
data:
  inline:
    - {team: North, score: 62}
    - {team: North, score: 65}
    - {team: North, score: 65}
    - {team: North, score: 68}
    - {team: North, score: 70}
    - {team: North, score: 70}
    - {team: North, score: 70}
    - {team: North, score: 72}
    - {team: North, score: 75}
    - {team: North, score: 78}
    - {team: North, score: 81}
    - {team: North, score: 90}
    - {team: South, score: 55}
    - {team: South, score: 58}
    - {team: South, score: 60}
    - {team: South, score: 61}
    - {team: South, score: 63}
    - {team: South, score: 63}
    - {team: South, score: 66}
    - {team: South, score: 69}
    - {team: South, score: 74}
    - {team: South, score: 77}
    - {team: South, score: 80}
    - {team: South, score: 84}
    - {team: West, score: 70}
    - {team: West, score: 72}
    - {team: West, score: 73}
    - {team: West, score: 73}
    - {team: West, score: 74}
    - {team: West, score: 75}
    - {team: West, score: 75}
    - {team: West, score: 76}
    - {team: West, score: 78}
    - {team: West, score: 79}
    - {team: West, score: 83}
    - {team: West, score: 88}
encoding: {x: team, y: score}
axes:
  y: {label: Score}
```

*Source: Illustrative values.*

Use the keyboard or pointer to read each point's value, team and row.
